months.6: Summer weather arrives and nearly the whole trail network is open. The full shuttle schedule is running, making it easier to reach trailheads as parking lots start to fill.
months.8: Late summer offers clear views from the granite summits, but the trails remain heavily crowded. The shuttle is the easiest way to reach the busiest trailheads.
months.10: Fall foliage makes the coastal and mountain views spectacular. The park is heavily crowded with leaf-peepers, so use the shuttle, which runs until mid-October, to reach the moderate and strenuous ridge hikes.

months.8: Hurricane season is under way, bringing intense rain and potential trail closures. The steep clay paths are extremely slippery and often washed out.
